official.deadline_note: No separate scholarship application and no published scholarship deadline: eligible applicants to the University are automatically considered, and the award is assessed once UWA Admissions receives final academic transcripts. Timing is therefore driven by the chosen course's application dates, not a scholarship closing date.
official.status_note: The official page currently invites students 'looking to start studying in 2027' to apply; the terms and conditions list the period of funding as 2027-2029.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Global Excellence Scholarship is an annual tuition fee discount for the normal full-time duration of the awardee's course as specified in their letter of offer; it is provided as a percentage fee discount towards eligible course fees.
benefits: Up to 20% off tuition fees for the entire duration of an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course (2027 start).
Undergraduate: 20% discount on tuition fees (equivalent ATAR 90+); 10% discount on tuition fees (equivalent ATAR 85-89.95).
Postgraduate: 20% discount on tuition fees (WAM 75+); 10% discount on tuition fees (WAM 65-74.99).
UWA's international scholarships overview publishes up to AUD$48,000 over 4 years on eligible undergraduate courses or up to AUD$24,000 over two years on eligible postgraduate courses.
Fees team automatically applies the scholarship to the student account before each semester's tuition payment is due.
eligibility: Students from all countries are eligible; the student must be an international student eligible for or holding an Australian student visa (subclass 500) or other visa category with study rights.
Must have applied to commence / received an offer for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework course for 2027 at UWA.
Undergraduate: equivalent ATAR of at least 85.00; Postgraduate: WAM of at least 65.00.
Must have not discontinued an equivalent level course with an immediate break in enrolment after discontinuation.
Must be enrolled full-time in the course for which the scholarship is awarded (unless the administration body is satisfied exceptional circumstances preclude full-time enrolment).
requirements: Equivalent ATAR of at least 85.00 for undergraduate entry or WAM of at least 65.00 for postgraduate entry.
Final academic transcripts must be submitted so UWA Admissions can assess scholarship eligibility; conditional offers may be issued without the scholarship.
Scholarship offer must be accepted within 30 days of the offer being made.

To keep the scholarship: continue to meet the eligibility requirements, make satisfactory progress in the course, maintain a WAM of 60 in the awarded course, and confirm twice annually that eligibility continues.
documents: Application to the chosen UWA course (submitted via the UWA application portal).
Final academic transcripts for the qualification used to gain entry.
Scholarship contract to sign if a conditional offer was already accepted when final transcripts are assessed.
selection_criteria: Academic achievement, determined by the applicant's equivalent ATAR or UWA WAM as determined by UWA Admissions.
Selection is made by UWA Admissions having regard to the applicant's academic records.
In exceptional circumstances the University may award the scholarship based on a predicted ATAR equivalent score.
coverage: 20% or 10% discount on tuition fees (percentage fee discount towards eligible course fees) for the standard full-time duration of the course.
Up to AUD$48,000 over 4 years on eligible undergraduate courses (published headline maximum).
Up to AUD$24,000 over two years on eligible postgraduate courses (published headline maximum).
The scholarship covers tuition only: no living costs, travel, or installation support is published.
application_method: No separate scholarship application is required; eligible applicants to the University are automatically considered.
Admissions assesses scholarship eligibility once final academic transcripts are provided; the outcome (if any) appears in the offer letter.
If a conditional offer was already accepted, Admissions provides a scholarship contract to sign and the scholarship amount is credited to the student account each semester.
official.application_route: Apply for admission to an eligible UWA course through the UWA application portal and submit final academic transcripts; the scholarship is then assessed automatically with no separate application.
official.study_mode: Full-time (part-time only where the University is satisfied exceptional circumstances preclude full-time enrolment)
official.citizenship_residency: Students from all countries are eligible; must be an international student eligible for or holding an Australian student visa (subclass 500) or other visa category with study rights.
official.international_eligibility: Open to international students from all countries; domestic students are not the target group for this award.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Eligible courses are undergraduate bachelor's pass, bachelor honours (integrated) and combined degrees, and graduate certificate, graduate diploma or postgraduate degrees by coursework or coursework and dissertation published in the UWA Handbook. Excluded: Assured Pathway to Medicine, Assured Pathway to Dental Medicine, Juris Doctor (20820), Doctor of Medicine (91850), Doctor of Dental Medicine (91860), Doctor of Optometry (91590), UWA Micro-credentials, and other quota-based postgraduate courses; non-AQF structured courses are not eligible. All combined bachelor's and combined bachelor's and master's degrees are eligible.
official.duration: The normal full-time duration of the awardee's course as specified in their letter of offer (undergraduate degrees with an assured pathway: undergraduate course only; combined bachelor's and master's: the whole combined duration; reduced-load study adds up to two additional semesters).
official.description: UWA describes the Global Excellence Scholarship as backing high-achieving international students to study further, offering up to 20% off tuition fees for the entire duration of an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course for students starting in 2027. It is an automatic, post-admission tuition fee discount whose value is set by the applicant's equivalent ATAR or WAM.
official.program_type: Automatic post-admission tuition fee discount (no separate scholarship application)

verification.notes: Amount, tiers, eligibility, continuation rules, exclusions and 2027-2029 funding period confirmed on UWA's own scholarship page and its full terms and conditions (F19/1756); headline AUD 48,000/24,000 caps confirmed on UWA's official UWA-funded scholarships page. No scholarship closing date is published; timing depends on course application and final transcript submission.

applicant_utility.summary: This is UWA's automatic tuition discount for high-achieving international coursework students starting in 2027: 20% off tuition fees at an equivalent ATAR of 90+ or WAM of 75+, and 10% at ATAR 85-89.95 or WAM 65-74.99, applied every semester with no separate application. Your only real task is to apply early to an eligible course and get final transcripts to Admissions quickly, because the scholarship is assessed from them and shows up in your offer letter or a contract to sign afterwards. Budget for everything else yourself: the award never touches living costs, flights, or insurance, and you must hold a WAM of 60 in your awarded course and re-confirm eligibility twice a year to keep it. Note the scholarship cannot be stacked with any other UWA fee reduction or academic scholarship (the UWA English Language Award is the sole exception), so choose whichever award is worth more.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving international school leavers (equivalent ATAR 85+) and postgraduate coursework applicants with a WAM of 65+ who want a discounted UWA degree without a separate scholarship application.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply to your eligible UWA course as early as possible - the scholarship is automatic, but assessment only happens once Admissions has your file.
Upload final academic transcripts (not predicted or conditional ones) as soon as they are released; the award cannot be assessed until then.

Check your intended course against the exclusion list before applying - Assured Pathways to Medicine/Dental Medicine, Juris Doctor, the three doctoral clinical programs and UWA Micro-credentials are out.
If you hold a conditional offer and have already paid, watch for the scholarship contract and sign it promptly; offers lapse if not accepted within 30 days.
Model your true budget with only a partial discount: full living costs, flights, OSHC and visa costs sit outside the award.
Plan your unit load to stay full-time; a reduced-load plan is only accommodated for exceptional circumstances and extends the award by at most two semesters.
common_rejection_risks: Applying with predicted or incomplete results and never following up with final transcripts - Admissions may issue a conditional offer with no scholarship attached.
Aiming for a course on the excluded list (doctoral clinical programs, Juris Doctor, Assured Pathways to Medicine/Dental Medicine, Micro-credentials) and assuming any UWA course qualifies.
A scores conversion landing just under the tier line - equivalent ATAR 84.95 or WAM 64.99 misses even the 10% tier, so get Admissions to confirm your equivalence before you rely on it.
Holding or accepting another UWA tuition reduction or academic scholarship, which makes this award unholdable concurrently.
Letting your WAM in the awarded course drop below 60 or skipping the twice-yearly eligibility confirmation, which ends the discount mid-degree.
Recent discontinuation of an equivalent-level course followed by an immediate break in enrolment, which is a stated ineligibility.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living expenses in Perth (accommodation, food, transport), overseas student health cover, student visa costs, return airfares, and the remaining 80-90% of tuition after the discount.
document_audit: Final, certified academic transcripts are the decisive document - predicted results trigger only a conditional offer without scholarship.
If you already accepted a conditional offer, the evidence of your scholarship is a signed scholarship contract, not the offer letter alone.
UWA determines your equivalent ATAR/WAM from the previous study used to gain entry and warns equivalent scores may vary, so keep the documentation behind your conversion available.
Study must be full-time in the awarded course; any reduced-load plan needs documented exceptional circumstances and committee approval for suspension.
alerts: There is no scholarship deadline to chase - but the practical deadline is your course application date plus how fast you produce final transcripts, so do not sit on them.
The offer window is short: the scholarship offer must be accepted within 30 days or it may be withdrawn.

The current structure is a percentage discount, so its dollar value rises with UWA's tuition fee levels and differs by course - treat any fixed dollar figure (AUD 48,000 / 24,000) as a headline maximum, not a guaranteed payment.
Deferral is safe: the scheme runs for 2027-2029 intakes, so deferring a 2027 start to 2028 retains the scholarship, but deferring beyond that range is not promised.
Conditions are subject to change and the programme is reviewed annually; you are assessed against the conditions current at the time of your application.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit a course application through the UWA portal, upload final academic transcripts, then wait for Admissions to attach the scholarship to your offer letter or send a scholarship contract to sign; the Fees team applies the discount automatically each semester before payment is due.
